subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature, folded into broader MEMORY.md/USER.md editing, or deferred to plugin-contributed Control UI panels?
rationale: The request changes persistent sensitive context behavior and overlaps memory, workspace-file, and plugin UI seams, while current main does not choose the storage, injection, freshness, or security contract.

options.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection mode, stale-fact handling, diff/audit UX, authorization, and tests before queueing implementation.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of a broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory panel if raw memory editing should own the user experience.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for Control UI plugin contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection mode, stale-fact handling, diff/audit UX, authorization, and tests before queueing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this owner to the Control UI plugin tab seam and the inspected Agents UI/gateway surfaces, and the decision crosses those product boundaries.
